# Korea Search & AI Audit Toolkit
> Google, Naver, and AI-search-related technical audit toolkit for public websites. Windows download, one-time purchase.

## Product
- Landing: https://dlaepdfuf89-crypto.github.io/korea-search-ai-audit/
- Sample report: https://dlaepdfuf89-crypto.github.io/korea-search-ai-audit/sample-audit-report.html
- Guides: https://dlaepdfuf89-crypto.github.io/korea-search-ai-audit/guides.html
- Basic: audits one public website and generates prioritized technical findings.
- PRO: compares the owner site with up to 3 competitors and tracks changes against a previous audit.

## Coverage
- Google search technical signals
- Naver/Yeti crawler accessibility
- robots.txt, sitemap.xml, canonical, noindex, metadata and structured-data signals
- AEO/GEO/AI-search-related public-page signals
- Machine-verifiable findings separated from items requiring human review

## Limitations
- Does not guarantee rankings, traffic, indexing, or AI citations.
- Public URLs only; no administrator credentials are required.
- Blocked or slow sites can produce partial audits.
